newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down ahead of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down ahead of settlement.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed lower on Monday amid position squaring ahead of settlement on Tuesday, dealers said.
"Early session short covering failed to inspire any fresh buying," dealer Shakeel Anwar said. Major investors squared their positions to let the market bottom out, he added.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 14.82 points, or 0.93 percent, to close at 1,576.01. Losers led gainers 188 to 83.
Hub Power Co fell 0.70 rupees to 38.10 rupees and ICI Pakistan 0.80 to 22.10. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
